instructions.what: Rate how much unintended confusion or frustration this play session shows. state.brief is the creator's intent (genre, mood, what the player should feel, things to avoid). state.facts.play describes one session in words, section by section: how much of the time the player stood still, how much they kept pushing forward without moving, how often they came back to places they had already left, falls, being sent back to a checkpoint after a fall or without one, how much they swung the camera around, repeated jumps in one spot, whether they got closer to the goal and how far it still was, and whether they reached it. Judge the player's state against what the brief intends: slow, careful movement with pauses and looking around can be exactly the intended experience in a horror or exploration game, getting a little lost can be intended in a maze, and repeated failed jumps are intended only when the brief asks for hard platforming.
instructions.not_for: Do not rate the game's difficulty or the player's skill in general. Do not count behavior the brief calls for as confusion. Judge only the sections described; the player field says whether a human played.

signals: the session flows as the brief intends
any pauses, looking around or failures are what the brief calls for
a short pause or one small detour, then steady progress

criteria.summary: Clear confusion or frustration in one section
signals: one section with long standing still, backtracking, repeated falls or pushing without moving that the brief does not intend
no progress for most of the session
the same failure again and again

notes: 0..4 の 5 段(0 = 困っていない)。★この質問では threshold.pass が「困っている線」: 値がこれ以上なら troubled。人のプレイだけ聞く(機械の軌跡は迷わないので聞かない)。閾値は評価ケースの実測で決める(初版は仮の 2)。
